summary: Collective Mining Ltd. filed a Form 6-K containing interim financial statements for the three months ended March 31, 2026, along with management discussion and analysis and certifications. The filing is a routine periodic report by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a quarterly report under US standards. No special-situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change—is disclosed. The filing is purely financial and operational in nature, with no event-driven catalyst.
